subject: Payment withheld — VAT residency change and disputed July invoice
messages:
From: Liam Harper <liam.harper@tidewave.io>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: Heather Cole <heather.cole@tidewave.io>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Payment withheld — invoice 6789 / VAT residency change

Hi Maya,

Quick heads up from AP: we received invoice 6789 for July usage but our tax team flagged the invoice as VAT not matching our updated EU residency (we switched entity to TideWave EU on 2026-07-01). Because of that discrepancy our accounts-payable team has put a payment hold for that invoice and related July invoices until we get corrected VAT evidence and a corrected invoice.

I attached the payment notice and the copy of how our tax team interpreted the charges. Can you confirm how Redwood will handle: corrected invoice (reverse-charge vs Redwood VAT), and whether Redwood can issue a goodwill/service credit to cover the delayed payment fees? We prefer not to hold open subsequent invoices.

Attachments: tidewave_withholding_notice.pdf, invoice_6789.pdf

Thanks,
Liam Harper
Finance Ops, TideWave Analytics
liam.harper@tidewave.io

From: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
To: Liam Harper <liam.harper@tidewave.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Payment withheld — invoice 6789 / VAT residency change

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and the attachments. Sorry for the friction here.

Short answer: we can (1) reissue a corrected invoice reflecting reverse-charge where appropriate, (2) provide our VAT registration proof and your requested tax docs, and (3) consider a one-time courtesy credit for any late-payment bank fees while we sort this.

Monica, can you pick this up on the corrected invoice and VAT proof? David, please confirm whether we can provisionally put a small goodwill/service credit against TW-2026-0048 while accounting finalizes — Liam is asking for coverage of bank/processing fees (they estimated ~€700).

Liam — can you send TideWave's EU VAT certificate (or the TIN used for the July invoices)? If you prefer, we can also route the corrected invoice through our EU billing entity; let us know which legal entity you want on the invoice.

I will aim to get a corrected invoice + VAT proof back to you within 48 business hours and a provisional credit memo same day.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
--
Redwood Inference — High-performance inference for production

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Liam Harper <liam.harper@tidewave.io>
Cc: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:34:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Payment withheld — invoice 6789 / VAT residency change

Hi Liam,

Thanks — received the docs. I had a look with our billing team. We can issue a corrected invoice under Redwood EU Services (VAT ID: EU-RW-334455) using the reverse-charge mechanism effective 2026-07-01. We'll attach our VAT registration and a corrected line-by-line reconciliation.

I have created a provisional credit memo for €700 (provisional_credit_700-USD.pdf) to cover the bank fees you noted; this will be posted as a goodwill/service credit against invoice 6789 pending final reconciliation. Once TideWave confirms the EU VAT certificate (we need the certificate image or TIN), we'll finalize the corrected invoice and clear the hold.

Attachments referenced: provisional_credit_700-USD.pdf

Next steps requested from TideWave:
- Send TideWave EU VAT certificate (scan or PDF) or confirm legal entity name for invoicing.
- Confirm bank fee amount if different from €700.

Once confirmed we will:
1) Post provisional credit memo (done same day)
2) Issue corrected invoice with reverse-charge
3) Send final paperwork for AP to release payment

Regards,
Monica Patel
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Liam Harper <liam.harper@tidewave.io>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: Heather Cole <heather.cole@tidewave.io>, accounts-payable@tidewave.io
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 09:01:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Payment withheld — invoice 6789 / VAT residency change

Thanks Monica — attaching TideWave EU VAT certificate and confirmation of legal entity (attached as tidewave_vat_certificate.pdf). Bank fees were an estimate; AP confirms actual processing fees of €645. Please adjust the provisional credit to €645 if possible.

AP will tentatively release the hold once they receive the corrected invoice and the credit memo. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Attachments: tidewave_vat_certificate.pdf

Liam Harper
Finance Ops, TideWave Analytics
liam.harper@tidewave.io

Hi Liam — confirming we updated the provisional credit memo to €645 (see attachment provisional_credit_700-USD.pdf updated copy in Drive link). Monica will issue the corrected invoice under Redwood EU Services with reverse-charge lines and our EU VAT registration attached.

I have also flagged this for priority processing so AP release can be completed as soon as TideWave confirms release. Expect final invoice + credit memo PDF within the next 3 hours.

If anything else slows the release, please loop me in.

Thanks,
